title: Objeto 3D de Vidrio Negro Transparente Hiperrealista: Diseño Flotante Minimalista Futurista
prompt: Create a hyperrealistic 3D rendered object in an ultra-modern transparent black aesthetic. The subject features a sleek, futuristic, minimalistic floating design made of transparent black glass or polymer material with a smooth curved texture and high-gloss finish that shows partial internal reflections. The visual language conveys cutting-edge sophistication. Lighting consists of rim light and directional top light at high intensity, creating soft diffuse glow underneath with sharp specular highlights and reflections across transparent surfaces. The color palette is dominated by pure black, very dark grey, and near-black tones with accents of pure white and medium grey, creating very high contrast with an overall dark, glossy, and luminous tone. The rendering style is 3D hyperrealistic with ultra-high resolution quality and depth effects showing floating volumetric space with layered reflections. The background is a pure dark void with the object centered and floating, emphasizing transparency and dramatic lighting in a 1:1 aspect ratio composition.
